title: Rolls-Royce — Visual Atlas Reconstruction Template
timebase: Integer 30 fps frames; frame 0 = 00:00:00:00; each atlas page spans 60 source frames; end frames are exclusive.
status: Reference-derived visual template and timing specification. It is not a rendered film. Source plates are not embedded because only the visual atlas PDF was provided.

reference.atlasPageRule: page n represents frames (n−1)*60 through n*60−1

visualGrammar: Alternate luxury-car plates entering vertically; smoke and scanline texture bridges angle changes.
Hold wheel detail while a brush mask reveals child/teddy; scale the car away.
Overlap retreating and advancing child/hall plates with title movement in foreground.
Drop image into radial tunnel, then resolve textured yellow/white chapter typography with scale/rotation settling.
Spin marque to rest, dip to dark, then build portrait/date/family/mill layers.
Carry translucent BANKRUPT type over mill/family and rural imagery; use forward zooms and radial exits.
Use railway-focused zoom into expanding irregular aperture; brighten landscape as boy and birds resolve.
Darken intimate family detail while school/work imagery replaces it.
Intercut debt title and food close-ups with HARD LABOUR over worker imagery.
Shift work/railway into fee close-up, then worker/tools/model-wheelbarrow inserts with radial bridges.

chapters.desc: Wheel close-up holds while brush mask reveals child and teddy; car recedes.

chapters.desc: Rotating marque to portrait and 1863; family cutouts and flour-mill exterior form the biography tableau.

chapters.desc: Smoke and translucent red BANKRUPT overlay; mill/family plates, forward zooms, distressed rural images.

chapters.title: Road, railway and boy

chapters.desc: Hand/baby details darken as school/work imagery takes over.

chapters.title: Debt, food and labor
chapters.desc: Red DEBT, bread/milk close-ups, yellow HARD LABOUR over worker imagery.

chapters.title: Apprenticeship and tools
chapters.desc: Fee close-up, worker/tools and model wheelbarrow inserts; dark industrial plates and bright radial bridges.
